title: Reading Drill — Designing a Quiet Workshop
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Designing a Quiet Workshop
passages.body:
**A** An adult education centre wanted to offer woodworking and language classes in adjoining rooms. A caretaker measured sound on both sides of the walls while another person moved the saw bench around the workshop.

**B** The wall facing the classroom was thick, but a hollow door transferred the highest-pitched sounds. The caretaker tested temporary edge seals before asking the centre to replace anything expensive.

**C** Sound levels fell enough to run most classes at the same time. Sessions involving the largest machines were still held during breaks, when the language classroom was empty.
